notes.subject: נסכתי
notes.rationale: נסך: 'kapsaitim oil long mi' (anointed), 'ol i pouim mi' (cast metal), o 'ol i setimapim mi' (established, KJV 'set up')

notes.subject: מעולם … מראש … מקדמי
notes.rationale: Tripela mem-prefix 'long/bipo' i serial — ritmis bilong stat-stat-stat, Tpi i trapim liklik tasol

translation: Long taim bipo tru ol i kapsaitim oil long mi, long hed stat yet, pastaim long graun i kamap.

tokens.gloss: ol i kapsaitim oil long mi
